name: daydream
description: Design tool for the web where real HTML/CSS is the grain: a canvas of viewports Codex can read, arrange and draft pages on through MCP, over the pages of the project folder it has open.

interface.shortDescription: A canvas of real HTML/CSS viewports over your project's own files.
interface.longDescription: Daydream is a design tool for the web where real HTML/CSS is the grain. With this plugin, Codex reads the canvas, whose viewports are the html files of the project folder Daydream has open, writes those files, builds pages piece by piece as drafts, and checks them with measured findings and the enabled plugins' gates. The host runs on your machine; nothing leaves it.
